about: Hand-verified call sites for scoring the code graph's CALL resolution (CODE-GRAPH P0, 2026-09-26). `unit` is relative to code_repos_dir; `file` is relative to the unit; `expect` is the qname really called, or null when the true answer is 'no first-party edge'. Each label was verified by reading the call site and the target definition; `files` pins the sha256 of every cited file so tools/code_graph_yardstick.py can tell a moved label from a vanished one. Stratified, not a random sample: categories are chosen to discriminate between resolvers, so its precision is not the population precision of a codebase.
